title: More Vino Brentwood: TT$175 Restaurant Week four-course menu
summary: More Vino's Brentwood branch has a TT$175 all-inclusive four-course Restaurant Week menu with seafood and sushi choices.
description: For Trinidad & Tobago Restaurant Week 2026, More Vino offers a starter, one appetiser, one entree and one dessert for TT$175 with taxes included. The offer runs September 25 through October 4 and is available at Brentwood Mall for dine-in or takeaway. Pescatarian choices listed include shrimp and vegetable tempura, Thai green curry shrimp and the Emperor Salmon Roll. The published menu does not provide dairy-allergen details, so dairy-free suitability is unconfirmed and should be checked with the restaurant before ordering.
